corpus: exact inherited 32 point_validation dates; no 2024 evaluation
timing_protocol: 10 warmups per condition; 5 repeats x 200 paired calls per runtime/scope; per-pair order shuffled before measurement with seed 17
validation: retain shape, mask, finite projected QKV and score-overflow rejection; reject training; manual weights on explicit request
inference_mode: torch.no_grad for both paths, matching NeuralBundle.predict
selection: no automatic runtime or model promotion; report gains and regressions per architecture
statistics: descriptive 95% bootstrap interval of mean speedup resampling 5 paired repeat blocks, 2000 draws; not accuracy significance
